$comment: Code-formatted names that the vocabulary pass of step 30 (HWC-VOCAB) cannot find in the installed packages and that a page keeps: { file, text, reason, approvedBy }, where text is the whole inline code value or the live-block term exactly as the finding prints it. The list is the lead's: writers propose entries in their result files and never edit it; every entry needs a reason and approvedBy, no wildcard is accepted, an entry that matches nothing fails the step, and the entries count towards the cap of five per page (lists.mjs).
